evidence.notes: A typed String query produces a cursor over persisted Account rows; its concrete result methods are asserted directly.
A typed String query with AccessLevel produces a cursor over persisted Account rows.
A typed String query and Map<String,Object> binds with AccessLevel produce a cursor over matching persisted rows.

source.content: Account first = new Account(Name = 'Cursor First', Rating = 'Hot'); Account second = new Account(Name = 'Cursor Second', Rating = 'Warm'); Account third = new Account(Name = 'Cursor Third', Rating = 'Warm'); insert new List<Account>{first, second, third}; Database.Cursor cursor = Database.getCursor('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account ORDER BY Name'); System.assertEquals(3, cursor.getNumRecords()); List<SObject> firstPage = cursor.fetch(0, 2); System.assertEquals(2, firstPage.size()); System.assertEquals('Cursor First', ((Account)firstPage[0]).Name); System.assertEquals('Cursor Second', ((Account)firstPage[1]).Name); List<SObject> finalPage = cursor.fetch(2, 1); System.assertEquals(1, finalPage.size()); System.assertEquals('Cursor Third', ((Account)finalPage[0]).Name); Database.Cursor accessCursor = Database.getCursor('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account ORDER BY Name', AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assertEquals(3, accessCursor.getNumRecords()); List<SObject> accessPage = accessCursor.fetch(1, 1); System.assertEquals(1, accessPage.size()); System.assertEquals('Cursor Second', ((Account)accessPage[0]).Name); Map<String,Object> binds = new Map<String,Object>(); binds.put('rating', 'Warm'); Database.Cursor boundCursor = Database.getCursorWithBinds('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Rating = :rating ORDER BY Name', binds, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, boundCursor.getNumRecords()); List<SObject> boundPage = boundCursor.fetch(0, 2); System.assertEquals(2, boundPage.size()); System.assertEquals('Cursor Second', ((Account)boundPage[0]).Name); System.assertEquals('Cursor Third', ((Account)boundPage[1]).Name); System.assertEquals(3, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account]);
